timeline.title: A Short History of Celebrating Dad
items: A town remembers
Fairmont, West Virginia, held a church service for the fathers lost in a mining disaster the year before.
A daughter's idea
Sonora Smart Dodd, raised by her widowed father, organised a Father's Day in Spokane in his honour.
The third Sunday
President Lyndon Johnson declared the third Sunday of June a day to honour fathers.
Here to stay
Father's Day became a permanent national holiday in the United States, and the idea kept spreading.
today: Not in the history books yet. But to us, the greatest dad there ever was.

letters.title: What the World Has Said About Dads
items: One father is more than a hundred schoolmasters.
George Herbert, 1640
It is a wise father that knows his own child.
William Shakespeare, The Merchant of Venice
You never really understand a person until you consider things from his point of view
Atticus Finch, in To Kill a Mockingbird by Harper Lee
A father is a banker provided by nature.
An old French saying
letters.hand: Wise words, all of them. Ours are simpler: thank you, {who}.

facts.title: The Science of Being a Dad
items: music
A familiar voice
Late in pregnancy, babies can hear voices outside the womb, so Dad sounds familiar early.
pulse
Built to care
Many new dads see their testosterone dip, which scientists link to being more caring and hands on.
hands
The cuddle hormone
Dads release oxytocin too, the bonding hormone, especially during play and cuddles.
smile
Rough and tumble
Researchers think playful wrestling with dads helps children learn confidence and when to stop.
heart
Seahorse dads
In seahorses it is the father who carries the eggs in a pouch and gives birth to the babies.
moon
Penguin night shift
Emperor penguin dads keep their egg warm on their feet for about two months of Antarctic winter.
facts.hand: Science can explain a lot. It still cannot explain how {who} finds the funny side of everything.

world.kicker: A thank you from all of us
world.title: Why the World Is Better With You in It
world.lead: Because of you, the world got:
items: A hug that makes everything feel safe.
Someone who can fix almost anything.
Jokes so bad they became good again.
A taxi service that never once sent a bill.
Advice that turned out to be right. Annoyingly.
The loudest cheer at every big moment.

world.close: The world is better because of you, {who}. Ours most of all.

To love you, always, wherever we are.

note.title: What we believe a dad is
paras: We make magazines for a living, but some feel different. This was one of them.
We believe a dad is not only the big moments. He is the hand on the back of the bike, the lift in the rain, the joke that lands badly and the hug that always lands well.
{who}, someone wanted you to have something special. Not a card anyone could buy, but pages full of you: your face, your words, the little things that make you, you.
That someone is {from}. And from everything they told us, you are loved more than you could ever know.
